target_customer: Non-native English speaking professionals who want to speak with confidence in meetings and interviews
problem: Most English learning apps target beginners and do not improve real conversation skills. Fluently provides an AI speaking coach with practice, feedback after calls and a personalized plan.
business_model: Consumer subscription mobile and web app

founders.name: Yurii Rebryk
prior_employers: Internships at Google, Nvidia, Lyft, Amazon (per YC page)
previous_startups: Deep tech startup with real-time face and voice swap for mobile, grown from 2 to 50 people (unnamed)
founders.background_notes: Former university roommate of co-founder, per press.

founders.name: Stanislav Beliaev
prior_employers: Internships at Google, Nvidia (per YC page)
previous_startups: Same deep tech startup as co-founder (unnamed)
founders.background_notes: Schools not named on YC page.

investors: angels including Burkay Gur, Alex Mashrabov, Arash Ferdowsi

technical_complexity.rationale: Real time voice conversation, pronunciation and fluency feedback relied on speech and language models available by 2023 and 2024, with latency and quality tuning as the hard parts.

defensibility.rationale: Consumer language apps and general voice assistants are easy to substitute; differentiation rests on product focus on professionals and call feedback.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Duolingo, Speak, ELSA, Loora and Praktika all offered AI speaking, and ChatGPT voice is a free alternative; no acquisition found.

market_need_then: Large global demand for English speaking practice and a funded category of AI speaking apps; company claims 25,000 plus professional users and over 1M Google Play downloads on its site.

branding.domain_note: Uses getfluently.app, a prefix and .app domain, not fluently.com

identity.voice_and_tone: Friendly, confidence focused, written from non-native founders' perspective

branding.community_and_virality: Trustpilot and App Store ratings of about 4.8 claimed on site; Product Hunt launches; best English learning app of 2025 mention by YouGlish on its blog

brand_strength.rationale: TechCrunch coverage, app store traction and review badges show moderate recognition, but the name is generic and shared with several unrelated apps.

outcome_analysis: Fluently raised a 2M seed in June 2024 right after YC Winter 2024 and reports over a million downloads and a 4.8 rating on its own site. It is active in 2026. The market is crowded with well funded AI speaking apps and free voice assistants, so its edge is focus on non-native professionals, and long term outcome is still open.
notes: Directories report 2.5M total across two rounds, so partial coverage; the second round is not identified. One directory lists a September 2025 acquisition of FonioAI, unconfirmed and not recorded. Competition list left empty: search found only 2026 dated roundups, none near the batch; the takeover_risk incumbents come from those roundups and are not dated to 2024. Scale figures (downloads, ratings, users) are company claims. Founders' schools not named.
